description: React component for a control that allows selecting between a fixed value or a metric, used in Apache Superset's explore controls.

classes.name: FixedOrMetricControl
classes.description: React component class for FixedOrMetricControl, managing state and rendering UI for fixed or metric selection.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change events, calling the onChange prop with current control state.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the control type to 'fix' or 'metric' and triggers onChange.

methods.name: setFixedValue
methods.description: Updates the fixed value in state and triggers onChange.

methods.name: setMetric
methods.description: Updates the metric value in state and triggers onChange.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including controls for fixed value or metric selection.
